metadata.case_name: KWOK KWAN LAM v. LAI PO SING AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: Multiple fractures of all 5 metatarsal bones of the left foot
source: tenderness on his chest and fractures of metatarsals with wound of the left foot ("the Injuries").
tenderness over right chest wall, an open wound and multiple fractures of all 5 metatarsal bones of the left foot.

injuries.description: Wound of the left foot with split-thickness skin graft (skin graft over the medial aspect of the left thigh)
source: Wound debridement and split-thickness skin graft was done on 27th June 2009 and 5th July 2009 respectively.
a 9 cm x 2.5 cm elliptical scar over the dorsum of the left foot;
a 12 cm x 3 cm scar from the skin graft over the medial aspect of the left thigh;
injuries.icd_description: Other specified open wound of ankle or foot

source: tenderness over right chest wall, an open wound and multiple fractures of all 5 metatarsal bones of the left foot.

manifestations.description: a 9 cm x 2.5 cm elliptical scar over the dorsum of the left foot
a 12 cm x 3 cm scar from the skin graft over the medial aspect of the left thigh
mild stiffness at the end range of extension of the 2nd to 5th toes and left ankle
mild angulation in the united fracture of the 3rd metatarsal
slight angulation at the fracture shaft of the left 5th metatarsal
dull ache upon walking over 2 hours
tiredness and ache in his foot upon standing over 3 hours
occasional spasm over the left foot extensor tendon lasting 30 seconds to 1 minute
was only able to walk with a pair of crutches for a period of 6 months after discharge, and eventually with a single crutch
presently still walking with minor discomfort and occasional pain in left foot; unable to work as efficiently as before

treatments_received: follow-up treatments at Department of Orthopaedics and Traumatology of Tuen Mun Hospital

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities including scarring, stiffness, angulation of metatarsals, and pain on prolonged standing/walking resulting in reduced function of the left foot and diminished work efficiency.

comparable_cases.case_name: Leung Chung Ngar Christover v. Yeung Man Wai & Anor
comparable_cases.injury_description: fracture of the metatarsal neck of the 3rd and 4th toes, and dislocation of the 5th metatarso-phalangeal joint when his left foot was run over by a motor car; close reduction and K-wires were performed.

comparable_cases.case_name: To Ying Wa v. Cargo-Land (warehouse) Development Limited
comparable_cases.injury_description: fractures of the 4th and 5th metatarsals of the right foot; operation of close reduction and K-wire fixation; plaster cast.

comparable_cases.case_name: Ho For Sang v. Lau Sun Choi and Chiu Kam Fat
comparable_cases.injury_description: foot injuries when a forklift truck ran over both his feet; dislocation and compound fracture; underwent surgery and skin grafting; significant residual disability; unlikely to return to workforce.

comparable_cases.case_name: Chow Tai Loi v. Leung Kam Hung and L H Godown Limited
comparable_cases.injury_description: hit by a truck which ran over his left foot, causing fractures of the 1st and 2nd metatarsals; minor chest injury; short leg cast for three weeks and physiotherapy.
